title: 대수기하학 원론 (EGA) — 한국어 누적판 / Éléments de géométrie algébrique — Korean Cumulative Edition
description:
읽기 / Read first: 00_EGA_ko_CUMULATIVE_READER.pdf는 이 공개판의 맨 앞 독자용 산출물이며, 현재까지 완성된 한국어 번역을 빠짐없이 담는다. 범위는 EGA I 앞부분과 서론, EGA 0_I 전부, 제I장 프로그램, 제I장 제1–9절 전부, 그리고 제10절 처음부터 제10.14절 끝까지이다. 번역은 제10.15절 직전에 끝나며, EGA I 또는 EGA 전집의 완성을 주장하지 않는다. source/CUMULATIVE_INPUTS.json은 모든 TeX 입력과 순서를 묶으며, 빠지거나 선언되지 않은 TeX 파일이 있으면 빌드는 실패한다.
00_EGA_ko_CUMULATIVE_READER.pdf is the front artifact of this release and contains the complete Korean translation available to date in this lineage: EGA I front matter and introduction, all of EGA 0_I, the Chapter I programme, Chapter I §§1–9 in full, and §10 from its beginning through the end of §10.14. It ends immediately before §10.15; neither EGA I nor the EGA corpus is claimed complete. source/CUMULATIVE_INPUTS.json binds every TeX input and its compilation order; the build fails closed on any undeclared or missing TeX file.

This Korean edition remains in one Zenodo language lineage. A continuing Figshare article is retained as a possible additive preservation lineage; its next upload remains blocked by an inactive/disabled account, so no current Figshare r23 mirror is claimed. It is a translation of and part of the stable global/source EGA object at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20414353. The public repository is https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/ega-ko. Editable TeX, exact source identities, decisions, corrections, build evidence, extraction checks, visual QA and SHA-256 manifests are included. Production contribution: AI typesetting & translation.
